data.name: Rok
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ruk’ which means rock. This name represents strength, courage, and vitality. It is also associated with the element of fire.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the inner strength and courage to overcome challenges in life. It is a reminder to remain steadfast and grounded, like a rock, during difficult times.
data.numerology_meaning: A name that encourages self-expression and creativity. People with this name often have a strong will and are natural leaders. They may also be impulsive and need to learn to think before they act.

data.cultural_impact: In Hindu mythology, the name Rok symbolizes resistance and stability, much like the unyielding nature of a rock. It is believed that individuals named Rok possess a strong, unwavering character and the ability to endure challenges.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name Rok signifies the inner strength and resilience that is essential for a spiritual journey. It also represents the fire that burns within us, fueling our passion and determination to pursue our spiritual goals.

name_in_real_life.story: Anita Rok, a teacher in Mumbai, India, shares that their name Rok meaning "Rock" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
